sources.text: The boiling, the cooling to 75-80 °C, the acid and the straining are from this article.

chhena.text: Milk is boiled, cooled slightly to 75–80 °C, and a food acid is stirred in. The curd separates at once from the greenish whey and is drained in a cloth.
